document.title: 2021 International Building Code
document.copyright_note: The source PDF is not redistributed. Only short, clause-specific excerpts needed for traceability are included.

rules.title: Minimum egress door clear opening width

source.excerpt: shall provide a minimum clear opening width of 32 inches (813 mm)

exceptions: The clause contains occupancy, door-type, dwelling-unit and width exceptions not modeled by this MVD.
The MVD evaluates a single leaf and does not infer occupant-load capacity.

mapping.interpretation: ClearWidth is treated as the clear opening measured with a swinging leaf open 90 degrees; OverallWidth is deliberately not substituted.

rules.review_note: Threshold and metric wording were manually checked against the local 2021 IBC PDF. Applicability exceptions are intentionally narrowed for a controlled demonstrator.

rules.title: Minimum egress door clear opening height

source.excerpt: minimum clear opening height of doors shall be not less than 80 inches (2032 mm)

exceptions: IBC 1010.1.1 contains several door-height exceptions; this MVD fixture does not model their triggering conditions.

mapping.interpretation: The authored property is treated as clear opening height; nominal OverallHeight is not assumed equivalent.

rules.review_note: Threshold was manually checked against the local 2021 IBC PDF; exception handling remains outside the MVD.

rules.title: Minimum means-of-egress ceiling height

source.excerpt: shall have a ceiling height of not less than 7 feet 6 inches (2286 mm) above the finished floor

exceptions: The eight exceptions in IBC 1003.2 are not inferred by this MVD.
Sloped ceilings and local projections require richer geometry and are routed to manual review in a production implementation.

mapping.primary: IfcSpace.Representation geometric bounding box in world coordinates
mapping.interpretation: For the controlled orthogonal fixtures, the vertical bounding-box extent is the floor-to-ceiling height. This is not valid for arbitrary sloped or stepped spaces.

rules.review_note: Threshold was manually checked against the local 2021 IBC PDF. The bounding-box interpretation is limited to controlled rectangular fixtures.

rules.title: Egress door direction of swing

source.excerpt: shall swing in the direction of egress travel where serving a room or area containing an occupant load of 50 or more persons or a Group H occupancy

exceptions: The MVD evaluates side-hinged controlled fixtures and does not infer door construction type.
The related-space occupancy context is an authored project mapping, not an IBC occupant-load calculation.

fallbacks: Pset_ComplianceContext.OccupancyGroup is used only when no IBC Occupancy Group classification relationship is present.
mapping.interpretation: A score of 1 means the normalized authored swing direction is EGRESS. Applicability is established from the related space occupant load or Group H classification.

rules.review_note: Applicability and direction wording were visually checked against PDF page 316. Project-specific occupancy mappings remain explicit evidence.

rules.title: Modeled means-of-egress continuity to exit discharge

source.excerpt: The path of egress travel along a means of egress shall not be interrupted by a building element other than a means of egress component

exceptions: This MVD checks graph connectivity only; it does not detect physical obstructions or verify capacity and width along the path.
A FAIL is allowed only when the author asserts that the exported topology coverage is complete.

mapping.interpretation: Breadth-first traversal returns 1 when a modeled boundary path reaches an authored exit-discharge door. The completeness assertion gates FAIL conclusions.

rules.review_note: Continuity wording was visually checked against PDF page 305. The implementation deliberately claims only graph connectivity, not full clause compliance.

rules.title: Door readily openable from the egress side

source.excerpt: egress doors shall be readily openable from the egress side without the use of a key or special knowledge or effort

exceptions: IBC 1010.2 and its subsections contain operational and occupancy-specific exceptions that require project review.

mapping.primary: Field observation and approved hardware schedule
mapping.interpretation: No IFC property is treated as proof that a door is readily openable without a key, special knowledge or effort.
manual_checklist: Operate the door from the egress side under representative conditions.
Confirm that no key or special knowledge is required.
Record hardware identity, observation, reviewer and timestamp.

rules.review_note: The operational wording was visually checked against PDF page 318. The rule is intentionally non-automated.
